theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_pp_hs_ideal
theorems.statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (X : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k) (Y : Rn k →L[ℝ] Rn m), (∀ (u : Rn m) (v : Rn k), inner ℝ (X u) v = inner ℝ u (Y v)) → hsNormSq Y = hsNormSq X) ∧ (∀ (m k p : ℕ) (Y : Rn k →L[ℝ] Rn p) (X : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), hsNormSq (Y ∘L X) ≤ ‖Y‖ ^ 2 * hsNormSq X) ∧ ∀ (m k p : ℕ) (X : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k) (W : Rn p →L[ℝ] Rn m), hsNormSq (X ∘L W) ≤ ‖W‖ ^ 2 * hsNormSq X
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
